description: This Java class 'EnumConfigField' defines a GUI component for selecting enumeration options within a configuration UI. It manages a combo box interface, handles incoming messages for updates, and sends user selections back to the system. The class extends 'BaseConfigField' and interacts with external configuration messaging and option data.

classes.name: EnumConfigField
classes.description: A UI component for selecting enum options in a configuration interface, with message listening and synchronization capabilities.

methods.name: EnumConfigField
methods.description: Constructor initializing the combo box with options and setting up message listener and action handler.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the selected item in the combo box based on an ordinal value.

methods.name: loadValue
methods.description: Loads and sets the value from a ConfigurationImage object.
